meta.title: eRFX RFQ project: counter offer rejected

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ response screen with Vendor A’s bid.
Send the buyer’s counter offer of 90 to Vendor A.
Verify that the counter offer is pending for Vendor A.
Move to Vendor A’s separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event overview where Vendor A can respond to the pending counter offer.
Confirm that the vendor portal shows the pending counter offer before rejecting it.
Reject the buyer’s counter offer as Vendor A.
Return to the buyer’s RFQ response screen.
Verify that the RFQ response view shows the original bid price held by the event, 100.
Open Master QCS to verify the restored bid in the buyer’s comparison grid.
Assert that Vendor A’s RFQ rate remains 100 after rejecting the counter offer.
